paper_metadata.title: A 3–10-GHz Low-Noise Amplifier With Wideband LC-Ladder Matching Network
paper_metadata.abstract: Reactive matching is extended to wide bandwidths using the impedance property of LC-ladder filters. In this paper, we present a systematic method to design wideband low-noise amplifiers. An SiGe amplifier with on-chip matching network spanning 3–10 GHz delivers 21-dB peak gain, 2.5-dB noise figure, and 1-dBm input IP3 at 5 GHz, with a 10-mA bias current.
